blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite the remarkable generalization capabilities of Large Language Models, generating clinically accurate and structured radiology reports from medical images remains a significant challenge. Current end-to-end approaches function as black boxes, prone to factual hallucinations and generating ungrounded findings. This lack of reliability and failure to adhere to domain-specific structuring protocols, fundamentally limits their clinical utility. We present MedPAO-VL, a multimodal agent that shifts the paradigm from monolithic generation to explainable, iterative, protocol-compliant structured report generation. Unlike deterministic models, our plan-act-observe loop functions as a goal-oriented agent: it first perceives the Chest X-Ray through an explainable vision module designed to capture inherent diagnostic uncertainty, then iteratively refines the generated report by observing semantic discrepancies and self-correcting its generation for better alignment with visually detected clinical findings. Evaluation of our framework demonstrates that this agentic reasoning improves clinical correctness and completeness, achieving an expert-rated accuracy score of 3.5/5 and a structural score of 4.3/5. By prioritizing pathology specific explainability and iterative refinement over opaque end-to-end mapping, MedPAO-VL offers a transparent and clinically viable alternative for automated structured radiology report generation.
blocks.zh: 尽管"大语言模型"具有显著的通俗化能力,但从医学图像中生成临床准确而有条理的放射学报告仍然是一个重大挑战. 目前的端到端方法作为黑盒发挥作用,容易发生事实幻觉并产生无根据的发现. 这种缺乏可靠性并未能遵守特定域的结构协议,从根本上限制了它们的临床效用. 我们介绍的是MedPAO-VL,这是一个多式联运代理商,它将模式从单体生成转向可解释、迭接、符合协议的结构化报告生成。 与定型模型不同的是,我们的计划-act-observator循环功能是面向目标:它首先通过一个旨在捕捉内在诊断不确定性的可解释的视觉模块来感知到胸X-Ray,然后通过观察语义差异并自我校正其生成,以更好地与可视检测到的临床结果相匹配来反复完善生成的报告. 对我们的框架的评价表明,这种代理推理提高了临床正确性和完整性,实现了专家评分为3.5/5分,结构分为4.3/5分. MeDPAO-VL通过将病理特定解释性和迭代改进置于不透明的端到端绘图之上,为自动结构放射学报告生成提供了透明和临床上可行的替代品。

blocks.en: Generating accurate and structured radiology reports remains a significant bottleneck in clinical workflows. Escalating volumes of medical imaging procedures exert immense pressure on radiologists, creating a critical need for automated systems that can reduce turnaround times and standardize reporting quality [ 14 ] . Yet in high-stakes clinical settings, automation alone is insufficient. Any deployed system must also be trustworthy : its outputs must be interpretable , its reasoning auditable , and its failure modes clinically safe. This demand has catalyzed two parallel, yet largely distinct, streams of research: end-to-end report generation from images and the post-hoc structuring of unstructured reports. The first stream is dominated by multimodal models that generate reports directly from medical images. While these models demonstrate considerable promise, they function as black-boxes, offering clinicians little insight into how a conclusion was reached. A further fundamental limitation lies in their training data, which operates on the flawed assumption that any pathology not explicitly mentioned in a ground-truth report is implicitly absent. This is clinically unsound: the absence of a finding may reflect a lack of observation rather than its confirmed absence, and encoding this ambiguity as ground truth undermines both model reliability and clinical trust. In contrast, the second stream prioritizes verifiable reasoning and strict protocol compliance. Frameworks such as MedPAO [ 55 ] employ an agentic loop to parse unstructured reports and transform them into a structured, protocol-compliant format like ABCDEF [ 24 ] (details in Supplementary material), producing outputs that are auditable and adherent to standardized guidelines. However, its primary limitation is its post-hoc nature: it structures existing text rather than reasoning from primary visual evidence, leaving the opacity of the upstream generative process unaddressed.
blocks.zh: 编写准确和有条理的放射报告仍然是临床工作流程中的一个重大瓶颈。 越来越多的医疗成像程序对放射学家造成巨大压力,因此迫切需要自动化系统,可以缩短周转时间,并使报告质量标准化[14]。 然而,在高发病率的临床环境中,单靠自动化是不够的。 任何部署的系统也必须是可信的:其产出必须是可解释的,其推理可以审计,其故障模式在临床上是安全的。 这一需求催化了两条平行但基本上截然不同的研究流:从图像生成端到端的报告和对无结构的报告进行事后结构化。 第一流以直接从医疗图像生成报告的多式联运模式为主。 虽然这些模型展现了相当大的希望,但它们作为黑匣子发挥作用,使临床医生对如何得出结论没有多少见解。 还有一个根本的局限性在于培训数据,其运作有缺陷的假设是,在地面真相报告中没有明确提到的任何病理学都是隐含的。 这在临床上是不可靠的:没有发现可能反映缺乏观察,而不是其经证实的缺失,并将这种模糊性编码为地面真实性破坏了模型的可靠性和临床上的信任。 相比之下,第二流则优先考虑可核查的推理和严格的协议遵守. MeDPAO[55] 等框架采用一种代理环路来分析无结构的报告,并将其转化为ABCDEF[24](补充材料中的细节)等结构化、符合协议的格式,产生可审计和遵守标准化准则的产出。 然而,它的主要局限在于它的后热性:它构建了现有文本,而不是从主要视觉证据中推理,使得上游基因过程的不透明性得不到解决.

blocks.en: This dichotomy exposes a critical gap at the intersection of explainability and generative capability. No existing solution integrates the visual reasoning power of multimodal models with the transparent, protocol-driven auditability of agentic frameworks, a gap that directly compromises the trustworthiness of automated radiology pipelines. To bridge this gap, we introduce MedPAO-VL (MedPAO-Vision-Language), a multimodal agent which is both end-to-end and transparent by design to generate structured, protocol-compliant reports from CXRs. By extending the MedPAO framework [ 55 ] with multimodal capabilities, we embed explainability into the generative process itself rather than as an afterthought. The key contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这种二分法暴露了在可解释性和遗传性能力的交汇点上的一个关键差距。 任何现有解决方案都无法将多式联运模型的视觉推理能力与代理框架的透明、协议驱动的可审计性结合起来,这一缺口直接损害了自动化放射管的可信赖性。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了MedPAO-VL(MedPAO-Vision-Language),这是一种多式联运代理人,通过设计可以产生有条理的、符合协议的CXR报告,既能端到端又具有透明度。 通过扩大具有多式联运能力的MedPAO框架[55],我们把可解释性嵌入基因过程本身,而不是作为事后思考。 这项工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Radiology Report Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 放射科报告的生成

blocks.en: Automated radiology report generation has emerged as a significant area of research, drawing initial inspiration from the successes of natural image captioning [ 63 , 38 , 47 ] . Foundational approaches to report generation established the encoder-decoder framework, initially employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) paired with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks [ 22 , 21 , 31 ] . With the advent of the Transformer [ 56 ] architecture, the field evolved to replace recurrent decoders with LLMs, yielding CNN-LLM configurations [ 27 , 17 , 65 ] . This evolution has culminated in Vision Transformers (ViTs)-LLM configurations [ 36 , 7 , 35 , 60 , 51 ] . Beyond the standard encoder-decoder paradigm, various lines of research have introduced architectural modifications and auxiliary techniques to achieve logical coherence and factual correctness by integrating memory-driven modules [ 4 , 49 , 13 ] , retrieval methods [ 11 ] with contrastive learning [ 44 , 32 , 10 ] , fine-grained lesion features [ 29 , 52 ] , and medical knowledge graphs [ 68 , 34 , 26 , 66 ] . More recently, the field is advancing towards native Vision-Language Models (VLMs) [ 48 , 54 , 41 , 64 ] and Generalist Medical AI (GMAI) [ 40 , 54 ] architectures. Unlike modular approaches that bridge separate pre-trained vision and language encoders, these foundation models are often trained end-to-end on vast, multimodal datasets. Agent-based frameworks offer a compelling alternative to monolithic LLMs by enabling task decomposition through specialized tools. For instance, a multi-agent architecture was recently proposed to handle disease-specific report generation by assigning specialized tasks to individual agents [ 58 ] . This concept was later extended by incorporating a Concept Bottleneck Model [ 25 ] to extract critical pathologies; these findings then serve as the foundation for a multi-agent RAG system designed to generate clinically grounded and transparent medical documentation [ 1 ] . While Foundational models, LLMs and VLMs excel at producing fluent and descriptive narratives, they fail to generate structured reports grounded in clinical protocols. Though existing agentic frameworks are robust, they often struggle with complex reasoning and factual hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 自动放射学报告生成已成为一个重要的研究领域,从自然图像标题[63、38、47]的成功中获得初步灵感。 报告生成的基础方法建立了编码器-解码器框架,最初采用革命神经网络(CNN)与长短记忆(LSTM)网络配对[22,21,31]. 随着变形器[56]架构的出现,这个字段逐渐演变,以LLMs取代了经常性的解码器,产生了CNN-LLM配置[27,17,65]. 这一演变最终形成了Visual Transformers(ViTs)-LLM配置[36,7,35,60,51]. 除标准编码器-解码器范式外,各种研究引入了建筑修饰和辅助技术,通过整合内存驱动模块[4,49,13],检索方法[11]与对比性学习[44,32,10],细纹损伤特征[29,52],医学知识图[68,34,26,66]实现逻辑一致性和事实正确性. 最近,该领域正在逐步走向本土视觉语言模型[48、54、41、64]和通用医学AI[40、54]建筑。 这些基础模型与将预先训练过的视觉和语言编码器分开的模块化方法不同,常常在庞大的多模式数据集上经过端到端的训练. 基于物剂的框架通过专门工具使任务分解,为单一的有限责任措施提供了令人信服的替代办法。 例如,最近建议建立一个多代理人架构,通过向个别代理人分配专门任务来处理具体疾病报告的生成。 这一概念后来通过纳入一个概念Bottleneck Model [25] 来扩展,以提取关键病理学;这些发现随后成为多剂RAG系统的基础,旨在生成临床基础和透明的医学文献[1]. 虽然基础模型、LLMs和VLM在制作流利和描述性叙述方面非常出色,但它们未能根据临床规程产生结构化报告。 虽然现有的代理框架是强有力的,但它们往往与复杂的推理和事实上的幻觉纠缠在一起。

blocks.en: 2.2 Explainable AI in Report Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 报告生成中的解释性AI

blocks.en: While recent models for automated report generation have achieved strong quantitative performance, their adoption in clinical practice hinges on meeting the critical requirement of explainability. To address this, a prominent line of research has focused on improving visual interpretability [ 62 , 57 ] . Several studies employed region-guided encoder networks that identify pathological areas and use these localized detections as grounded cues for generation [ 52 , 67 , 2 ] . Other approaches integrated radiologists’ eye-gaze data as a supervisory signal to train more explainable image encoders [ 45 ] . Further enhancing this paradigm, methods with learnable query tokens optimized visual processing while yielding interpretable spatial attention maps through cross-attention mechanisms [ 59 , 9 ] . In parallel, a distinct set of approaches prioritized concept-level explainability [ 20 , 11 ] over spatial heatmaps. These methods output discrete, scalar intermediate representations, to construct more informative prompts for an LLM-based report generator. Extending this idea, other works explicitly extracted key clinical findings from reports using frameworks like RadGraph [ 19 ] and leveraged these structured entities to guide the generation process [ 61 , 30 ] . With the exception of PromptMRG [ 20 ] , existing methodologies generally operate under the implicit assumption that pathologies not explicitly documented in the reference reports are absent. Furthermore, all of these approaches rely on general purpose LLMs to extract clinical concepts, which lack verification by radiologists.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近自动生成报告的模式取得了强有力的数量性能,但在临床实践中采用这些模式取决于能否满足解释性的关键要求。 为了解决这一问题,一线突出的研究侧重于提高视觉解释性[62,57]. 一些研究采用区域指导编码器网络,确定病理地区,并将这些局部探测作为发电的底线[52、67、2]。 其他方法将放射学家的眼光数据集成为监督信号,以训练更能解释的图像编码器[45]. 进一步加强这一范式,具有可学习查询符的方法优化了视觉处理,同时通过交叉注意机制生成可解释的空间关注地图[59,9]. 与此同时,一套独特的方法将概念层面的可解释性[20、11]置于空间热图之上。 这些方法输出离散的Scalar中间表示,为基于LLM的报告生成器构建更丰富的提示. 扩展了这一想法,其他工作明确利用RadGraph[19]等框架从报告中提取了关键的临床发现,并利用这些结构化实体指导生成过程[61,30]. 除了PowerMRG[20]之外,现有方法一般在隐含的假设下运作,即参考报告中没有明确记录的病理。 此外,所有这些方法都依靠一般目的的LLMs来提取临床概念,而临床概念缺乏放射学家的核实。

blocks.en: 3.1 Vision Concept Module
blocks.zh: 3.1 远景概念单元

blocks.en: Mitigating Implicit Negative Bias
blocks.zh: 减轻隐性消极偏见

blocks.en: Radiology reports frequently omit unresolved or expected findings, reflecting clinical prioritization rather than documented absence [ 46 ] . However, prominent AI frameworks [ 16 , 57 ] typically enforce a closed-world assumption by applying U-Zeros strategies [ 18 ] to map unmentioned or "uncertain" annotations to definite negatives. This introduces an implicit negative bias that corrupts training signals, suppresses uncertainty, and distorts spatial grounding. To eliminate this bias, we formulate pathology prediction as a three-class problem. Given a CXR image x x , the model predicts a label from { present , absent , uncertain } \{\textit{present},\textit{absent},\textit{uncertain}\} for each of n n target pathologies. This tripartite scheme mirrors clinical differential diagnosis by explicitly distinguishing true absence from reporting omission. Fig. 2 (a) represents an overview of proposed vision model.
blocks.zh: 放射科报告经常省略未解决或预期发现,反映临床优先,而不是有记录的缺课[46]. 然而,突出的AI框架[16,57]一般通过应用U-Zeros策略来将未提及或"不确定"的说明映射到确定的负数上来强制执行封闭世界假设. 这带来了一种隐含的负面偏见,它腐蚀了训练信号,抑制了不确定性,扭曲了空间地面. 为了消除这种偏差,我们把病理预测作为一个三等问题来进行. 鉴于一个 CXR 图像 xx, 该模型预测出来自 {当前, 缺席, 不确定 } { textit{现在},\ textit{absent},\ textit{ 不确定 } 的标签, 每个 n 目标病态 。 这一三方计划通过明确区分真实缺勤与漏报来反映临床差异诊断. 图2(a)概述了提议的愿景模式。

of spatial tokens and d d is the feature dimension, the PSM disentangles the

blocks.en: 3.2 Concept Grounded Report Generator
blocks.zh: 3.2 概念报告生成器

blocks.en: The Concept Grounded Report Generator is a multimodal model tasked at synthesizing a fluent, unstructured report. Unlike unconstrained generation, this module adopts a concept-driven approach: it receives both the CXR image and semantic constraints, a list of present and absent clinical concepts from the Vision Concept Module and renders these findings into medically coherent report. This dual-input design serves two complementary purposes. First, by grounding the generation on a curated concept vocabulary rather than raw image features alone, the outputs become traceable to discrete, verifiable clinical findings. This traceability is a critical prerequisite for clinical trustworthiness, allowing practitioners to audit the specific concepts driving any narrative statement. Second, utilizing the image as an active visual reference provides the necessary multimodal context to produce naturally expressive descriptions, avoiding the disjointedness of mere concept concatenation.
blocks.zh: 概念基础报告生成器是一种多式联运模式,负责综合一份流畅、无结构的报告。 与不受约束的生成不同,本模块采用了概念驱动的方法:它既接收CXR图像,又接收语义约束,这是远景概念模块中现今和缺失临床概念的清单,并将这些发现转化为医学上一致的报告. 这种双重投入设计有两个相辅相成的目的。 首先,通过将这一代人建立在一种经整理的概念词汇上,而不是仅仅以原始图像特征为基础,这些产出可以追溯到离散的、可核实的临床发现。 这种可追溯性是临床可信赖性的关键前提,允许从业者审计任何叙述性陈述的具体概念. 第二,利用图像作为积极的视觉参考,提供了必要的多式联运背景,可以自然地作出表达性描述,避免单纯的概念结合的脱节。

blocks.en: 3.3 The Agentic PAO Loop
blocks.zh: 3.3 代理PAO循环

blocks.en: The PAO loop shown in Fig. 2 (c) is an iterative loop that adapts to the complexity of the clinical findings, by offering the following capabilities:

blocks.en: Self-Correction Loop and Report Structuring. After extracting the visual findings, the agent begins by initiating the Concept Grounded Report Generator to produce an initial findings narrative. To ensure clinical fidelity, the Observe phase employs Semantic Overlap Checker. This module extracts clinical entities from the generated narrative and computes the semantic similarity against the concept list C ^ \hat{C} from the Vision Concept Module. If the checker identifies a discrepancy, the agent triggers a Re-Plan and Act cycle. In this phase, the generator is re-prompted to refine the specific section containing the discrepancy. This loop continues for up to N iterations or until the vision concept list C ^ ⊆ CurrentFindings \hat{C}\subseteq\text{CurrentFindings} . After loop termination, the agent uses various tools from MedPAO like concept extraction, ontology mapping, concept categorizer and structured report generator to structure the free-style report according to a given clinical protocol. Refer to Supplementary for an end to end example of MedPAO-VL.

blocks.en: Amortized Efficiency via Concept Caching. To mitigate the computational overhead of iterative agentic loops, the PAO framework employs a Dynamic Concept Cache for ABCDEF protocol categorization. By storing and retrieving mappings for frequently recurring CXR findings, the agent bypasses high-latency Ontology Mapping , and Categorizer tool invocations on cache hits. New mappings are dynamically cached, allowing the system to reuse prior knowledge and optimize inference (see Supplementary for further details on PAO implementation).
blocks.zh: 通过概念缓存而摊还的效率。 为了减少迭代代理环路的计算间接费用,PAO框架采用了ABCDEF协议分类的动态概念缓存. 通过存储和检索经常重复的CXR发现的映射,代理绕过高相关性的肿瘤映射,并在缓存点击上引用分类器工具. 新的绘图是动态缓存的,使系统能够重新利用先前的知识并优化推论(关于PAO执行的进一步详情,请参见补充).

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset & Pre-processing
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: We utilize a subset of MIMIC-CXR [ 23 ] to train both the Vision Concept Module and the Concept Grounded Report Generator. We selected studies where the reports explicitly contain HISTORY , FINDINGS , and IMPRESSION sections, yielding approximately 53,000 CXR–report pairs from the train set. The FINDINGS section serves as the primary input to our concept extraction pipeline, which identifies salient clinical findings from free-form text. We leveraged the same concept extraction pipeline from [ 55 ] which was validated on a gold standard dataset annotated by radiologists. Since a same observation may be expressed in many linguistic forms, the extracted concepts are normalized to canonical SNOMED CT ontology using the medical entity normalization model [ 33 ] , enabling uniform grouping across heterogeneous representations of similar findings. An LLM (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B [ 12 ] ) is used to separate the present and absent concepts within each group. After radiologists validation, low-frequency or incoherent groups are filtered out, producing a final vocabulary of 236 unique, standardized concept groups. Additional details on radiologist validation is in Supplementary material. At the end of pre-processing steps, the curated dataset comprises approximately 50,000 (CXR, report, concept) triplets that form the basis for all models presented in this work. We utilize MIMIC-CXR [ 23 ] test set and IU-XRAY [ 6 ] test set for evaluation and the same pre-processing pipeline is applied on the test set to obtain ground-truth concepts from radiology reports, against which all models are validated. Additional details on data curation are provided in Supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们利用MIMIC-CXR[23]的子集来培训远景概念单元和概念基础报告生成器。 我们选择了报告明确包含HISTORY、FINGS、IMPRESSION部分的研究, FININGS部分是对我们概念提取管道的主要投入,它从自由格式文本中找出了显著的临床发现. 我们利用了来自[55]的同一概念提取管道,该管道在放射学家注解的黄金标准数据集上得到验证。 由于同样的意见可以用多种语言形式表达,所摘取的概念通过医学实体正常化模式[33],被正规化为犬科SNOMED CT肿瘤学,从而能够将类似发现的不同表述进行统一分类。 使用LLM(DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B [12])来区分各组中目前和缺失的概念. 放射学家验证后,低频或不连贯的组被过滤出,产生236个独特,标准化的概念组的最终词汇. 关于放射学家鉴定的其他细节见补充材料。 在预处理步骤结束时,整理的数据集包括大约5万个(CXR,报告,概念)三胞胎,这些三胞胎构成了本作品中所有模型的基础. 我们利用MIMIC-CXR[23]测试集和IU-XRAY[6]测试集进行评价,测试集采用同样的预处理管道,从放射报告中获取地面真实概念,对照这些概念验证所有模型。 关于数据整理的其他细节见补充材料。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: For training the Vision Concept Module , the dataset obtained in sub-section 4.1 is partitioned into a 90:10 train–validation split using stratified sampling on the clear lungs pathology. We use the MedSigLIP vision encoder [ 48 ] as a fixed backbone, operating on an image resolution of 448x448. The PSM block produces 236 pathology-specific slots corresponding to the 236 target concepts. The similarity loss weight is set to λ sim = 3 \lambda_{\text{sim}}=3 . We train for 50 epochs using AdamW with a cosine learning rate schedule, an initial learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , and a batch size of 32. For the Concept Grounded Report Generator , we finetune MedGemma 4B [ 48 ] on 10,000 samples for ablation studies and utilize the best hyperparameters to scale the training over 50,000 samples. All the experiments were conducted on a single NVIDIA A6000 (48 GB) GPU. Further implementation details are provided in Supplementary material.

blocks.en: 4.3 Report Generation Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 报告生成评价

blocks.en: Unstructured Report Evaluation
blocks.zh: 无结构的报告评价

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 and Table 2 , the proposed Concept Grounded Report Generator sets a new benchmark for clinical accuracy in chest X-ray report generation. Our 10K and 50K variants, which represent the report generator fine-tuned on 10,000 and 50,000 samples respectively, demonstrate the scalability of our approach. Specifically, the 50K variant achieves a state-of-the-art CheXbert-F1 [ 50 ] of 0.617 and a RadGraph-F1 [ 19 ] of 0.427 on the MIMIC-CXR dataset, substantially outperforming significantly larger models such as MAIRA-2 [ 2 ] and Flamingo-CXR [ 53 ] . This superior performance in clinical metrics, paired with a high CheXbert Micro-F1 of 0.706, underscores the model’s ability to correctly identify pathologies and map complex anatomical-clinical relationships. Furthermore, even the 10K variant remains competitive against SOTA baselines, validating the effectiveness of our radiologist-validated concept standardization even when fine-tuned on a smaller subset of data (compared to 1M samples in MAIRA-2 and 500K in Flamingo-CXR). While our model remains competitive in NLG metrics, the high GREEN [ 43 ] mean scores (0.733 for IU X-RAY) highlight that our generated reports maintain high clinical utility and diagnostic integrity, effectively minimizing critical omissions compared to existing generative approaches.

blocks.en: Structured Report Evaluation
blocks.zh: 结构化报告评价

blocks.en: To evaluate the quality of the generated structured radiology reports, we defined two primary scoring metrics: (1) an Accuracy Score , which measures the clinical correctness of the generated findings, and (2) a Structural Score , which assesses the extent to which the generated reports conform to the predefined reporting protocol. The evaluation was conducted by two senior radiologists on a balanced subset of 50 cases drawn from the MIMIC-CXR test set. To ensure a representative evaluation, these cases were selected via stratified random sampling, which preserved the underlying distribution of both CheXpert labels [ 18 ] and report complexity (utilizing an is complex flag for reports containing ≥ 9 \geq 9 concepts; refer to Supplementary material). For each case, the radiologists were presented with samples consisting of reports generated by our agent and reports produced by the MedGemma-27B multimodal model, along with the corresponding CXR image and the ground-truth report. To ensure an unbiased assessment, the radiologists underwent a blinded evaluation, without knowledge of the method responsible for generating the report. The mean evaluation results across all assessed cases are reported in Table 3 . Full inter-rater statistics, score distributions and the scoring criteria are described in Supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 为了评价所生成的结构放射学报告的质量,我们确定了两个主要的评分指标:(1) 精确分数,用来衡量所生成结果的临床正确性;(2) 结构分数,用来评估所生成的报告在多大程度上符合预先确定的报告协议。 两名高级放射学家对从MIMIC-CXR测试套中抽取的50个病例进行了平衡的子集评价。 为了确保进行有代表性的评价,通过分层随机抽样选择了这些案例,这保留了CheXpert标签的基本分布[18]和报告复杂性(对载有XX9\geq 9概念的报告使用一个复杂的旗帜;参考补充材料)。 对每一种情况,都向放射学家提供了样本,包括我们代理人生成的报告和MedGemma-27B多式联运模型编写的报告,以及相应的CXR图像和地面实况报告。 为确保无偏见的评估,放射科医生在不了解负责编写报告的方法的情况下进行了盲目评估。 对所有评估案例的平均评价结果见表3。 在补充材料中描述了全面分数之间的统计、分数分布和分数标准。

blocks.en: To evaluate the representational fidelity of the PSM, we analyze inter-slot cosine similarity of the final context vectors U T U_{T} . Context vectors are unit-normalized and projected onto a 2D plane anchored to a reference pathology, revealing clinically coherent directional structure: related findings cluster near the reference axis while opposing pathologies are displaced into the negative half-space. For likely pneumonia (Fig. 3(b) ), hazy bilateral parenchymal opacities ( cos = + 0.985 \cos{=}{+}0.985 , 9.7 ∘ 9.7^{\circ} ) and likely loculated fissural fluid ( cos = + 0.985 \cos{=}{+}0.985 , 3.1 ∘ 3.1^{\circ} ) align tightly with the reference, consistent with classical radiographic presentation, whereas pneumothorax ( cos = − 0.281 \cos{=}{-}0.281 ) and normal pleural surfaces ( cos = − 0.348 \cos{=}{-}0.348 ) are geometrically opposed. For mild CHF (Fig. 3(a) ), mild pulmonary vascular congestion ( cos = + 0.893 \cos{=}{+}0.893 ) and tiny pleural effusion ( cos = + 0.696 \cos{=}{+}0.696 ) project positively as expected sequelae of elevated hydrostatic pressure, while emphysema with right apical bulla ( cos = − 0.360 \cos{=}{-}0.360 ) and low lung volumes ( cos = − 0.377 \cos{=}{-}0.377 ) are displaced into the opposing quadrant, reflecting their association with obstructive rather than congestive physiology. These geometric relationships demonstrate that the PSM encodes clinically meaningful differentials as directional structure in embedding space. For further analysis on clinical co-occurrence of learnt pathology embeddings refer to Supplementary material.

blocks.en: We evaluated the representational fidelity of the PSM using t-SNE over the 236-dimensional slot activation space. A significant emergent property is observed: while the model was never trained to categorize findings into the ABCDEF protocol, the latent vectors naturally organize into clusters that coincide with these anatomical categories. To ensure a balanced representation, we utilized a stratified subset of 4,000 slot instances per category from the MIMIC-CXR test set. We employed a cosine distance metric for the projection to prioritize vector similarity over absolute magnitude, effectively capturing the diagnostic relationships within the high-dimensional manifold. As shown in Fig. 4 , the distinct spatial separation between Airways (A), Breathing (B), and Circulation (C) clusters validates that our concept-driven architecture disentangles co-occurring pathologies based on their anatomical origin. This alignment provides a verifiable diagnostic manifold that mirrors radiological reasoning, bridging the gap between deep vision features and clinical interpretability. Extended qualitative analysis of per-slot tsne plot can be found in Supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5.1 Vision model ablations

blocks.en: As presented in Table 4 , we compare successive stages of the vision model design using standard classification metrics. The Baseline configuration corresponds to directly using the vision backbone features followed by 236 independent classification heads for multi-label prediction. Incorporating the PSM module yields a modest improvement over the Baseline while additionally enabling the generation of interpretable attention maps. The PSM variant with a shared classifier further improves performance while reducing the overall parameter count. Finally, introducing the similarity loss has minimal impact on the quantitative metrics but noticeably enhances the quality of the attention maps by encouraging more diverse, pathology-specific focus patterns.
blocks.zh: 如表4所示,我们使用标准分类指标比较了远景模型设计的各个阶段。 基线配置对应的是直接使用视觉主干功能,然后是236个独立的分类头来进行多标签预测. 纳入PSM模块比基线略有改进,同时也有助于生成可解释的注意地图。 带有共享分类器的PSM变体在降低总参数计数的同时,进一步提高了性能. 最后,引入相似性损失对定量计量的影响微乎其微,但通过鼓励更加多样化的病理特异性聚焦模式,明显提高了关注图的质量.

blocks.en: 5.2 Impact of Concept Grounding
blocks.zh: 5.2 概念定位的影响

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , the finetuned MedGemma-4B model significantly outperforms both the 4B and 27B zero-shot baselines. This result strongly suggests that task-specific adaptation is far more critical for generating high-quality reports than raw model scale alone, making finetuning an essential step. However, the most critical comparison is between the finetuned model without concepts and our complete proposed model. As the results demonstrate, incorporating medical concepts yields performance boost, positioning our proposed model clearly ahead of all other variants. This jump highlights that the concept integration provides the crucial semantic grounding to achieve the highest level of clinical accuracy and fluency.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,微调后的MedGemma-4B模型大大超过4B和27B零射线基线。 这一结果强烈表明,针对具体任务的适应对编制高质量报告而言,远比仅原始模型规模更为关键,使微调成为重要的一步。 然而,最关键的比较是在没有概念的微调模型和我们提出的完整模型之间。 正如结果所表明的那样,纳入医学概念可促进业绩,使我们提出的模式明显地高于所有其他变体。 这一跳跃凸显了概念集成为实现最高水平的临床准确性和流畅性提供了关键的语义基础.

blocks.en: The PAO ablations shown in Table 6 comprises of three different combinations tested on MIMIC-CXR test. For all the experiments the maximum number of refinement steps is set to 3. The deterministic baseline experiment runs all the tools sequentially and achieves a concept coverage ratio( ϕ + \phi^{+} ) of 0.602 0.602 , indicating that approximately 40 % 40\% of vision module predicted findings are silently omitted from the final freestyle report. Introducing the Self Correction loop(PAO Full, Cold Cache) raises ϕ + \phi^{+} to 0.803 0.803 and improves ChexBERT-F1 [ 50 ] , Radgraph-F1 [ 19 ] and GREEN [ 43 ] scores, with a mean iteration count of 2.8 2.8 confirming that the loop triggers genuine re-planning in the large majority of reports rather than terminating in a single pass. While iterative repair increases mean LLM calls from 6.0 6.0 to 11.2 11.2 , the warm-cache condition recovers this overhead substantially, by retrieving previously computed concept-to-ABCDEF mappings from the cache. Through caching the frequent findings, inference time is reduced from 295 295 s to 163 163 s, a 45 % 45\% reduction while quality metrics remain unchanged.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MedPAO-VL, a transparent, multimodal agent designed to generate protocol-compliant, structured radiology reports. Unlike opaque end-to-end models, MedPAO-VL integrates generative capabilities with verifiable agentic reasoning to yield explicit explainability maps and auditable intermediate reasoning traces. The architecture’s three core components - the Vision Concept Module, the Concept Grounded Report Generator, and the iterative PAO loop - work in concert to preserve the inherent uncertainty of clinical observations, provide faithful visual localization, and enforce strict adherence to medical ontologies. Extensive evaluations confirm that our approach produces reliable, factually consistent, and protocol-compliant structured radiology reports. Despite these strengths, the system’s current diagnostic reach is constrained by a predefined vocabulary of 236 concept groups, limiting the documentation of ultra-rare anomalies. Future work will address this limitation by dynamically expanding the clinical vocabulary and extending the agentic framework to accommodate multi-modal imaging and broader diagnostic workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MedPAO-VL,这是一种透明、多式联运的代理,旨在生成符合协议的结构化放射学报告。 与不透明的端到端模型不同,MedPAO-VL将基因能力与可核查的代理推理结合,以产生明确的可解释性地图和可审计的中间推理痕迹. 该架构的三个核心组成部分 -- -- 愿景概念模块、概念定位报告生成器和迭代PAO循环 -- -- 协同工作,以保持临床观察的内在不确定性,提供忠实的视觉定位,并强制严格遵守医学本体学。 广泛的评价证实,我们的方法产生了可靠、事实一致和符合规程的结构式放射报告。 尽管有这些优势,但该系统目前的诊断范围受到236个概念组的预先定义词汇的限制,限制了超稀有异常的文献记录. 今后的工作将通过动态扩展临床词汇和扩大代理框架,以适应多种模式的成像和更广泛的诊断工作流程,来解决这一局限性。

blocks.en: Appendix 0.A The ABCDEF Protocol for Systematic CXR Interpretation
blocks.zh: 附录0.A 系统化CXR解释ABCDEF议定书

blocks.en: Chest radiograph interpretation is a foundational clinical skill that is prone to errors of omission when approached unsystematically. To mitigate this risk, the ABCDEF mnemonic has been widely adopted as a structured, sequential framework for reviewing chest X-rays (CXRs), ensuring that all anatomical regions and radiological domains are evaluated before a diagnostic impression is formed [ 24 ] . Each letter of the mnemonic corresponds to a distinct category of findings, as summarised in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 胸腔放射图解释是一种基础临床技能,在非系统接触时容易出现遗漏错误. 为减轻这一风险,已广泛采用ABCDEF模型,作为审查胸部X射线(CXR)的分阶段、顺序框架,确保所有解剖区和放射域在形成诊断印象之前都得到评估[24]。 如表7所示,元音的每个字母都对应一个独特的结论类别。

blocks.en: Evaluation begins at the midline with the trachea, which should be central at the sternal notch, with a permissible slight rightward deviation at the aortic arch. The trachea is traced inferiorly to the carina, where it bifurcates into the right and left main bronchi; the normal carinal angle is less than 105 ∘ 105^{\circ} (mean 80 ∘ 80^{\circ} ). Deviation of the trachea toward a hemithorax may indicate ipsilateral volume loss (e.g., lobar collapse or fibrosis), while contralateral displacement suggests a space-occupying process such as a large pleural effusion or tension pneumothorax. Intraluminal masses, extrinsic narrowing, and splaying of the carina are additional findings sought at this stage.
blocks.zh: 评估从中线开始,气管在胸口应处于中心位置,主动脉拱门可允许略偏右。 气管被低级地追溯到carina上,它将左右主胸骨分化成两侧;正常的carinal角小于105 ∘ 105^{\circ}(平均80∘ 80^{\circ}). 气管向异位激素的偏移可能表明外侧体积损失(如输卵管坍塌或纤维化),而反侧转移则表明空间占用过程,如大型胸膜充血或张力肺炎。 在目前阶段,人们还寻求其他的发现,包括内质、外质缩小和肉卷。

blocks.en: Both lungs should be symmetrically expanded and of similar volume. The lung parenchyma is assessed for focal consolidation, ground-glass opacification, interstitial changes, nodules, and masses. Pulmonary vascularity is examined for redistribution (upper lobe diversion) or congestion. The pleural spaces are inspected for effusion (blunting of the costophrenic angles), pneumothorax (visible pleural line with absent lung markings peripherally), or pleural thickening.
blocks.zh: 两肺应均匀扩张,体积类似. 评估肺部的分泌为焦聚物、地镜透明化、间质变化、结核和质地。 肺血管性被检查为再分配(上叶分流)或拥塞. 对胸腔空间进行检查,以便进行洗涤(润滑油角度)、肺炎(在外侧没有肺部标记的可见胸膜线)或胸膜增厚。

blocks.en: The cardiac silhouette is assessed for size and morphology. On a standard posteroanterior (PA) film, the cardiothoracic ratio should not exceed 0.5; values above this threshold indicate cardiomegaly. Individual cardiac borders are inspected for clarity, as loss of definition localises underlying parenchymal pathology (e.g., right heart border effacement in right middle lobe consolidation). The mediastinal contours are reviewed for widening, masses, and lymphadenopathy. The aortic knuckle, aortopulmonary window, and hilar structures are specifically assessed, along with the pulmonary vasculature for signs of hypertension or oedema.
blocks.zh: 心肌淤积按体积和形态评估. 在标准的后置胶片(PA)上,心肌比不应超过0.5;高于这个阈值的值表示心肌. 检查单个心脏边框是否清晰,因为定义的缺失是下丘病理(例如右中叶的右心脏边框擦除)。 对介质轮廓进行审查,以了解其扩大、质量和淋巴性。 主动脉关节,主动脉窗,以及耳球结构,连同肺血管,专门评估高血压或水肿的症状.

blocks.en: The right hemidiaphragm normally sits 1–2 cm higher than the left. Both domes should have smooth contours with sharp, acute costophrenic angles bilaterally. Elevation of a hemidiaphragm may indicate phrenic nerve palsy, lobar collapse, or a subphrenic process. Free subdiaphragmatic air (pneumoperitoneum) is a critical finding indicative of visceral perforation and is seen as a radiolucent crescent beneath the diaphragm on erect films. Subdiaphragmatic structures visible on the CXR—including gastric distension, hepatosplenomegaly, and abdominal calculi—are also reviewed at this stage.
blocks.zh: 右侧的螺旋藻通常比左侧高出1–2厘米。 两个圆顶都应该有光滑的轮廓,以尖锐,尖锐的杂费角度进行双边交流. 异丁二酰胺的升华可能表明发热神经麻痹,洛巴崩塌,或出现亚ph过程. 自由亚膜空气(pneumoperitoneum)是显示内膜穿孔的关键性发现,被看成是竖立的胶片上隔膜下的一个放射色月亮. CXR上可见的分膜结构——包括胃分解、肝脏分泌和腹腔分泌——也在这一阶段得到审查。

blocks.en: The osseous structures are examined systematically: the clavicles, scapulae, ribs (posterior and anterior arches), sternum, and visible thoracic vertebrae are assessed for fractures, lytic lesions, and deformities. Rib fractures are of particular clinical significance as they may indicate an underlying pulmonary contusion or haemopneumothorax. Soft tissues are reviewed for subcutaneous emphysema, asymmetric breast shadows, and abnormal calcifications or masses.
blocks.zh: 对骨骼结构进行系统的检查:骨折、骨骼、肋骨(前后拱门)、胸骨和可见的胸椎被评估为骨折、淋巴损伤和畸形。 肋骨骨折具有特别的临床意义,因为它们可能表明肺部下垂或出血性肺炎。 对软组织进行皮下气肿,不对称乳房阴影,以及异常的钙化或质团的审查.

blocks.en: The final step involves cataloguing all implanted or inserted devices and verifying correct positioning. Endotracheal tube tips should lie 3–5 cm above the carina. Nasogastric tubes should course below the diaphragm into the gastric body. Central venous catheters should terminate at the cavoatrial junction. Pacemaker and implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) leads are traced from the generator (typically in the left infraclavicular region) to their respective cardiac chambers. Surgical clips, prosthetic heart valves, and other foreign bodies are also documented.

blocks.en: The MedPAO framework [ 55 ] introduced an LLM-driven agent designed to transform unstructured, free-text Chest X-Ray (CXR) findings into standardized, protocol-compliant structured reports. Coordinated by a central LLM orchestrator, the system utilizes a suite of clinically validated tools:
blocks.zh: MeDPAO框架[55]采用了LLM驱动剂,旨在将无结构、自由文本的胸X射线(CXR)结论转化为标准化、符合协议的结构化报告。 该系统由一个中央LLM管弦乐团协调,使用一套经临床验证的工具:

blocks.en: 1. Concept Extractor: This tool distills raw clinical text from radiologists into discrete key findings. By shifting the architecture to a concept-centric paradigm, the system significantly reduces the noise and redundancy inherent in natural language. Powered by a medical LLM fine-tuned on a mixture of expert-annotated and synthetic corpora, this tool mitigates hallucinations by outputting both the discrete concepts and their corresponding source sentences. These sentence pairings subsequently serve as explainable reasoning traces for clinical auditing. 2. Ontology Mapper: This module grounds the extracted concepts within standardized medical ontologies, specifically SNOMED CT. Operating via an external API call, it queries the ontology to retrieve a candidate set of matching terms, along with their associated descriptions and hierarchical ancestors, for each extracted clinical finding. 3. Ontology Filter: Due to the one-to-many nature of ontological mapping, a reasoning model is employed to disambiguate the candidate terms. Utilizing the contextual evidence provided by the source sentences from the Concept Extractor, this tool classifies the retrieved SNOMED CT candidates into primary and secondary matches for each concept. 4. Concept Categorizer: This reasoning module maps the filtered, grounded concepts to appropriate target categories defined by the specified clinical protocol (e.g., the ABCDEF format). 5. Structured Report Generator: A general-purpose LLM synthesizes the final output. Rather than merely concatenating the extracted findings, it leverages the categorized concepts, their source sentences, and the structural guidelines of the clinical protocol to generate a cohesive, medically accurate, and naturally phrased structured report.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 概念解析器 : 这个工具将放射学家的原始临床文本提炼成离散的关键发现. 通过将架构转向以概念为中心的范式,系统大大减少了自然语言固有的噪音和冗余. 这个工具由医学LLM在专家说明和合成蝎子的混合物上进行微调,通过输出离散的概念和相应的源句来缓解幻觉. 这些句子配对后来成为临床审计的可解释推理痕迹. 2. 肿瘤制图员: 这个模块将所提取的概念作为标准化医学本体学,特别是SNOMED CT的基础。 它通过一个外部API呼叫进行操作,它询问本体学,以检索一个候选的匹配术语集,以及它们相关的描述和等级祖先,每个提取的临床发现. 3. 肿瘤过滤器:由于肿瘤绘图的一对多种性质,采用了推理模型来分解候选术语. 本工具利用概念解析器中来源句提供的背景证据,将检索到的SNOMED CT候选人分类为每个概念的初级和二级匹配. 4. 概念分类: 这个推理模块将被过滤,基于的概念映射到指定的临床协议定义的适当目标类别(如ABCDEF格式). 5. 结构化报告生成器: 一个通用LLM合成最终输出. 它不单单是整理所提取的研究结果,而是利用分类概念、其源句和临床协议的结构准则,生成一个连贯的、医学上准确的和自然结构化的报告。

blocks.en: After performing the overlap verification, if the set of missing concepts is non-empty, the Orchestrator receives a signal from the Observe state indicating that narratives corresponding to the uncovered concepts must be generated. If some concepts remain uncovered, the procedure is repeated for a predefined number of iterations N N . Conversely, once the generated freestyle report successfully incorporates all concepts predicted by the vision module, the iterative loop terminates and the orchestrator proceeds to the subsequent protocol-based report generation stage.

blocks.en: We used a finetuned Medgemma-4b [ 48 ] Multimodal model for the Concept Grounded Report Generation Tasks. To reduce memory overhead, we loaded the Medgemma-4b [ 48 ] in 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) quantization. We applied Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 15 ] , with a rank(r) of 32 and an alpha of 64, and a dropout probability of 0.05. Fine-tuning was performed on a 50,000-report subset for four epochs using AdamW as optimizer with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule, a batch size of 4, and gradient accumulation over 64 steps. During inference, reports were generated with a maximum of 150 new tokens. All the experiments are done with a random seed of 42. This quantized PEFT setup reduces memory consumption sufficiently to fine-tune on a single NVIDIA A6000 (48 GB) GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个微调的Medgemma-4b[48]多式联运模式,用于概念基础报告生成任务。 为了减少内存的超高,我们用4位的普通Float(NF4)量子化装入了Medgemma-4b [48]. 我们通过Low-Rank适应(LORA)[15]应用了参数-有效微调(PEFT)[15],等级为32级,α为64级,辍学率概率为0.05。 对5万个报告子集进行了精细调整,用于4个纪元,使用AdamW作为优化器,学习率为2×10−4 2\times 10×4 4},余弦表,批量尺寸为4,梯度累积超过64步. 在推论期间,产生了最多150个新信使的报告。 所有实验都是用42的随机种子完成的. 这种量化的PEFT设置可以将内存消耗降低到足以在单NVIDIA A6000(48 GB)GPU上微调.

blocks.en: To assess the quality of the generated structured radiology reports, we introduced two key scoring metrics: (1) an Accuracy Score, which measures the clinical correctness of the generated report against the original MIMIC-CXR reference reports, and (2) a Structural Score, which evaluates the degree to which the generated reports adhere to the defined reporting protocol. These metrics provide a comprehensive assessment of both the medical validity and standardized formatting of the outputs. The assessment process involved presenting radiologists with paired samples - our system-generated structured reports, MedGemma-27b [ 48 ] multimodal model generated structured reports alongside their corresponding MIMIC-CXR images and reference reports. This side-by-side comparison enabled direct evaluation of report quality against established clinical standards. Radiologists evaluated each report pair blindly (without knowing which report corresponds to which method) using the standardized metrics outlined in Tables 9 and 10 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估所生成的结构放射学报告的质量,我们采用了两个关键的评分指标:(1) 准确性分数,对照最初的MIMIC-CXR参考报告衡量所生成报告的临床正确性;(2) 结构分数,评价所生成报告遵守既定报告协议的程度。 这些衡量标准全面评估了产出的医疗有效性和标准化格式。 评估过程包括提供配对样本的放射学家 -- -- 我们系统生成的结构化报告,MedGemma-27b[48]多式联运模型连同相应的MIMIC-CXR图像和参考报告生成结构化报告。 进行这种逐一比较后,就可以按照既定的临床标准对报告质量进行直接评价。 放射学家利用表9和表10概述的标准化衡量标准,盲目(不知道哪份报告与哪一种方法相对应)评估每份报告。

blocks.en: Inter-rater agreement ranged from fair to moderate ( κ \kappa = 0.22–0.51, quadratic weighted), consistent with published radiologist agreement rates on subjective report quality assessment. Tanno et al. [ 53 ] highlighted this inherent subjectivity by demonstrating that a panel of 27 radiologists reached unanimous agreement on report preference in only 27.4% of cases for complex datasets, reflecting the nuanced nature of clinical quality judgments. The lower κ \kappa observed for MedPAO-VL accuracy (0.222) compared to MedGemma-27B (0.510) is consistent with this phenomenon: outputs of greater clinical nuance are harder to score consistently than reports with clearly identifiable deficiencies. blocks.en: The data curation pipeline comprises four key stages, as illustrated in Figure 8 .

blocks.en: Figure 8 : The entire Data preprocessing pipeline for extracting standardized concepts from clinical reports
blocks.zh: 图8:从临床报告中提取标准化概念的整个数据预处理流程

blocks.en: 1. Concept Extraction: We leverage the MedPAO concept extractor [ 55 ] to automatically identify clinical findings within radiology reports. A few-shot prompting strategy is used to query the model for candidate concepts along with the corresponding source sentences, thereby minimizing hallucinations and providing inherent explainability by linking each concept to its originating text span. If the extractor produces invalid or incomplete outputs, the model is re-prompted until a valid set of concepts is obtained. This procedure is applied to all reports, resulting in a structured collection of report–concept–evidence triplets. 2. Concept Segregation: Once all concepts are extracted for each report, the next step involves grouping them into Present and Absent categories to support downstream standardization. We begin by aggregating the full set of unique extracted concepts (shown in row 1 of Table 12 ) and pass them to a large language model with instructions to assign each concept or pathology to one of the two categories. For this classification step, we utilize the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B model [ 12 ] . This yields two structured outputs: a list of concepts classified as Present and another comprising those inferred as Absent . The counts of unique Present and Absent concepts are provided in rows 2 and 3 of Table 12 . 3. Concept Standardization: To enable consistent normalization, we first convert all Absent concepts into their corresponding Present forms using an LLM (e.g., transforming “no pneumothorax” into “pneumothorax”). These generated Present counterparts , together with the originally extracted Present concepts, form the unified set used for standardization. For ontology mapping, we employ the state-of-the-art concept normalization model SapBERT [ 33 ] , using SNOMED CT as the target ontology due to its comprehensive coverage of clinical findings. SapBERT embeds each concept and matches it to the closest SNOMED CT entry (e.g., CONCEPT ID, ANCESTORS) based on embedding similarity, producing a standardized medical term. Finally, we post-process the outputs by restoring the standardized Present counterparts back to their original Absent forms. This yields a complete set of concepts—each labeled as Present or Absent and linked to a corresponding SNOMED CT identifier. 4. Concept Filtering: After obtaining the SNOMED CT mappings for each concept along with their Present / Absent labels, we construct an inverted index in which each SNOMED CT identifier serves as a key, and its value is a dictionary grouping the corresponding Present and Absent concepts. This restructuring yields SNOMED CT–centric concept groups (the unique number of such groups is mentioned in row 4 of Table 12 ), each representing all variants mapped to the same ontology term. Using the original extracted concepts, we compute the occurrence frequency of each SNOMED CT group across the dataset. These frequencies are then used to filter out low-support groups based on a predefined threshold. Specifically, we discard any group with a total frequency below 100. Applying this criterion reduces the overall set of groups to 236, which serve as the final classification labels for our vision model, which can also be seen in row 5 of Table 12 .
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 概念提取: 我们利用MedPAO概念提取器[55]在放射学报告中自动识别临床发现. 使用几发提示策略来查询候选概念的模型以及相应的源句,从而通过将每个概念与其起始文本跨度联系起来来尽量减少幻觉,并提供内在的解释性. 如果提取器产生无效或不完整的输出,则该模型会被重制,直到获得一套有效的概念. 这一程序适用于所有报告,导致有条理地收集报告-概念-证据三重证据。 2. 概念隔离: 一旦为每份报告摘取了所有概念,下一步就是将它们分为现有和缺失类别,以支持下游标准化。 我们首先汇总了一整套独特的概念(在表12第1行中显示),然后将它们传给一个大语言模型,并指示将每个概念或病理学指定为两类之一。 对于这个分类步骤,我们使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B模型[12]. 这产生了两个结构化的产出:一个是被归类为“现在”的概念清单,另一个是被推定为“缺席”的概念清单。 表12第2和第3行列出了独特现成和缺失概念的计数。 3. 概念标准化: 为了实现一致的正常化,我们首先利用LLM(例如,将“无肺炎”转变为“肺炎”)将所有缺失的概念转换成相应的现成形式。 这些概念与最初提取的当前概念一起构成标准化所用的统一集。 在肿瘤学绘图方面,我们采用了最先进的概念正常化模型SapBERT[33],由于SNOMED CT全面覆盖了临床发现,因此使用SNOMED CT作为目标肿瘤学. SapBERT嵌入了每个概念,并将其匹配到最接近的SNOMED CT条目(如CONCEPT ID,ANCESTORS),基于嵌入相似性,生成一个标准化的医学术语. 最后,我们在完成产出后,将标准化的目前对应方恢复到原先的缺席表格。 这就产生了一套完整的概念——每个概念都标注为“存在”或“不存在”,并与相应的SNOMED CT标识符连接。 4. 概念过滤: 在获得每个概念的SNOMED CT映射及其当前/缺失的标签后,我们构建了一个倒置索引,其中每个SNOMED CT标识符作为键,其值是将相应的当前/缺失的概念组合在一起的字典. 这种重组产生SNOMED CT- 核心概念组(表12第4行提到了这类组的独特数目),每个组代表了按照同一个本体学术语绘制的所有变体。 使用原始提取的概念,我们计算了各数据集SNOMED CT组的发生频率. 然后利用这些频率根据预先确定的阈值过滤出低支持组. 具体地说,我们抛弃了频率低于100的任何群体。 应用这一标准,将总体组别减少到236个,作为我们视觉模型的最终分类标签,也可以在表12第5行中看到。

blocks.en: Concept Extraction: We leverage the MedPAO concept extractor [ 55 ] to automatically identify clinical findings within radiology reports. A few-shot prompting strategy is used to query the model for candidate concepts along with the corresponding source sentences, thereby minimizing hallucinations and providing inherent explainability by linking each concept to its originating text span. If the extractor produces invalid or incomplete outputs, the model is re-prompted until a valid set of concepts is obtained. This procedure is applied to all reports, resulting in a structured collection of report–concept–evidence triplets.

blocks.en: Concept Segregation: Once all concepts are extracted for each report, the next step involves grouping them into Present and Absent categories to support downstream standardization. We begin by aggregating the full set of unique extracted concepts (shown in row 1 of Table 12 ) and pass them to a large language model with instructions to assign each concept or pathology to one of the two categories. For this classification step, we utilize the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B model [ 12 ] . This yields two structured outputs: a list of concepts classified as Present and another comprising those inferred as Absent . The counts of unique Present and Absent concepts are provided in rows 2 and 3 of Table 12 .

blocks.en: Concept Standardization: To enable consistent normalization, we first convert all Absent concepts into their corresponding Present forms using an LLM (e.g., transforming “no pneumothorax” into “pneumothorax”). These generated Present counterparts , together with the originally extracted Present concepts, form the unified set used for standardization. For ontology mapping, we employ the state-of-the-art concept normalization model SapBERT [ 33 ] , using SNOMED CT as the target ontology due to its comprehensive coverage of clinical findings. SapBERT embeds each concept and matches it to the closest SNOMED CT entry (e.g., CONCEPT ID, ANCESTORS) based on embedding similarity, producing a standardized medical term. Finally, we post-process the outputs by restoring the standardized Present counterparts back to their original Absent forms. This yields a complete set of concepts—each labeled as Present or Absent and linked to a corresponding SNOMED CT identifier.

SapBERT嵌入了每个概念,并将其匹配到最接近的SNOMED CT条目(如CONCEPT ID,ANCESTORS),基于嵌入相似性,生成一个标准化的医学术语. 最后,我们在完成产出后,将标准化的目前对应方恢复到原先的缺席表格。 这就产生了一套完整的概念——每个概念都标注为“存在”或“不存在”,并与相应的SNOMED CT标识符连接。

blocks.en: Concept Filtering: After obtaining the SNOMED CT mappings for each concept along with their Present / Absent labels, we construct an inverted index in which each SNOMED CT identifier serves as a key, and its value is a dictionary grouping the corresponding Present and Absent concepts. This restructuring yields SNOMED CT–centric concept groups (the unique number of such groups is mentioned in row 4 of Table 12 ), each representing all variants mapped to the same ontology term. Using the original extracted concepts, we compute the occurrence frequency of each SNOMED CT group across the dataset. These frequencies are then used to filter out low-support groups based on a predefined threshold. Specifically, we discard any group with a total frequency below 100. Applying this criterion reduces the overall set of groups to 236, which serve as the final classification labels for our vision model, which can also be seen in row 5 of Table 12 .

blocks.en: Segregation of Normal and Complex Reports: To facilitate effective training of the language decoder, we partition the dataset into Normal and Complex reports based on the number of extracted concepts. Normal reports tend to be shorter, containing fewer concepts and fewer words, whereas Complex reports exhibit higher concept density and longer narrative descriptions. Using a threshold of nine concepts, we categorize each report into one of these two groups. Figure 11 shows the word-count distributions for both categories. As expected, the Complex reports exhibit higher mean and median word counts compared to Normal reports, supporting the validity of our concept-based segmentation strategy. Summary statistics for both groups are provided in Table 13 . Notably, the dataset contains fewer Complex reports, suggesting that many studies correspond to normal or near-normal findings, or that reporting styles across data sources frequently favor concise descriptions. This stratified separation is instrumental in constructing balanced train-validation-test splits for fine-tuning the grounded report generation model.

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the learned pathology embeddings of the Pathology Slot Module (PSM) capture real-world clinical relationships, we analyze the cosine similarity matrix of these learned pathology embeddings. As illustrated in the global heatmap encompassing all target concepts (Fig. 14(a) ), the latent space predominantly maintains orthogonality, indicated by the widespread neutral and negative similarities. This is a critical property which confirms that the slots representations successfully resisted feature collapse, thereby preserving the strict diagnostic specificity required to differentiate distinct pathologies.
blocks.zh: 为了评价所学的病理学嵌入法(Pathology Slot Module)(PSM)是否捕捉现实世界临床关系,我们分析这些所学的病理学嵌入法的余弦相似性矩阵. 如涵盖所有目标概念的全球热图(图14(a))所示,潜在空间主要保持正交,其表现是普遍的中性和负面相似性。 这是一种关键的属性,它证实,插槽代表成功地抵御了特征崩溃,从而保持了区分不同病理所需的严格诊断特性。

blocks.en: Amidst this orthogonality, the model exhibits localized blocks of high positive correlation. A high-resolution cross-section of the "Breathing" (Category B) pathologies (Fig. 14(b) ) explicitly validates that these correlations are not noise, but rather emergent encodings of clinical co-occurrence. Rather than isolating every finding independently, the manifold tightly aligns embeddings where clinical presentation frequently overlaps. For instance, biapical scarring and bibasilar airspace opacities demonstrate a strong semantic alignment with a cosine similarity of 0.91. This effectively mirrors the common co-occurrence of these findings in patients with chronic pulmonary architectural changes, confirming that MedPAO-VL’s internal representations natively align with established medical epistemology.
blocks.zh: 在这种正统性中,模型显示出具有高度正相关性的局部块。 "呼吸"(B类)病变(图14(b))的高分辨率截面明确证实,这些关联性不是噪音,而是临床共生的出现编码. 与每个发现独立隔离,不同的是,在临床表述经常重叠的地方,嵌入式紧密结合。 例如,两栖疤痕和两栖空域的不透明性表明,其语义上与0.91的余弦相似性很强。 这实际上反映了这些发现在慢性肺结构变化患者中常见的共性,证实了MedPAO-VL的内部表述在本土上与既定的医学流行病学一致.

blocks.en: To further investigate the discriminative power of the Pathology Slot Module (PSM), we perform per-pathology t-SNE projections of the context vectors U T U_{T} across the test set. A notable observation from figure 15 shows the high degree of latent separability achieved for rare but visually distinct objects, such as dual lead left-sided pacer devices and chest tubes . Despite the "Uncertain" class dominating the majority of the latent space, the positive clinical instances congregate in highly localized, high-density clusters. Furthermore, for acute pathologies like pulmonary edema , the model exhibits a clear class-conditional separation. The positive clusters are spatially removed from the negative background, proving that the PSM maintains diagnostic specificity even in complex, multi-pathological images. These analysis confirms that each slot successfully specializes in a unique visual signature, effectively disentangling medical findings from the global image features.

blocks.en: As discussed Loss Formulation, the initial formulation of the model incorporating the Pathology Slot Module failed to produce spatially distinct attention maps for different pathologies. To mitigate this issue, a similarity loss ( L s ​ i ​ m L_{sim} ) was introduced to discourage redundant attention patterns across slots. The qualitative impact of this modification is illustrated in Figure 16 , which presents a side-by-side comparison of the attention maps generated with and without the inclusion of L s ​ i ​ m L_{sim} .
blocks.zh: 如讨论的那样,最初拟订的模型采用了病理学分层模块,但未能为不同的病理学绘制空间上不同的注意图。 为了缓解这一问题,引入了类似损失(L s i m L_{sim}),以阻止跨槽的多余关注模式。 图16说明了这一修改对质量的影响,图16对使用和不使用Ls i m L_{sim}生成的注意力图进行了边际比较。

blocks.en: In the absence of the similarity loss, the model tends to adopt a “lazy” strategy by concentrating its attention on a limited region of the image. This behavior is evident in Figure 16(a) , where the model consistently focuses on the top-left corner irrespective of the pathology being considered. In contrast, incorporating L s ​ i ​ m L_{sim} encourages the model to distribute its attention more diversely across relevant regions.
blocks.zh: 在没有相似性损失的情况下,该模型倾向于采用“懒惰”策略,将注意力集中在图像的有限区域。 这种行为在图16(a)中明显可见,该模型始终关注左上角,无论考虑的是何种病理. 与此相反,纳入Ls i m L_{sim}鼓励该模式在相关区域更加多样化地分配注意力。

blocks.en: A similar pattern is observed in Figure 16(b) , where the model without the similarity loss predominantly attends to the top-right edge of the image. The introduction of L s ​ i ​ m L_{sim} alleviates this issue, resulting in more spatially meaningful attention maps that better correspond to the underlying pathologies. Therefore, beyond improving the quantitative performance of the model, the similarity loss plays a crucial role in enhancing the interpretability and quality of the generated explanation maps.
blocks.zh: 图16(b)中观察到类似的模式,没有相似性损失的模型主要在图像的右上边缘。 引入Ls i m L_{sim}缓解了这个问题,从而产生了更具有空间意义的关注地图,更好地与基本病理对应. 因此,除了改进模型的定量性能外,相似性损失在提高生成的解释地图的可解释性和质量方面发挥着关键作用。

objective through a “lazy” strategy that ignores slot-specific distinctions,
yielding attention maps that are visually indistinguishable and therefore
clinically uninformative.
blocks.zh:
在这个堕落的体系中,模型满足了分类
以“懒惰”战略实现目标,这种战略忽略了具体时间档的区别,
产生视而不见因而
临床上无信息。

blocks.en: To demonstrate the auditable reasoning capabilities of MedPAO-VL, we provide a step-by-step trace of the system processing a highly complex case. blocks.en: MedPAO-VL follows a PAO loop logic and strategically employs the LLM engine during both the Plan and Observe states of the agent’s operational cycle. In the Plan state, the MCP client queries the LLM by providing contextual information including available tools and any previously executed steps, prompting (Figure 18 ) the engine to determine the next appropriate tool along with its specific parameters. During the Observe state, the system presents (Figure 19 ) the LLM with both the tool-generated output and the original user query, requesting an evaluation of whether the response adequately addresses the initial request. Based on this assessment, the LLM decides whether to continue iterating through the cycle or terminate the process and return the current output as final. All the individual tool calls of the system uses different prompt to carry out the tasks: Concept Extraction (Figure 20 ), Concept categorization (Figure 21 ) and the Structured report generation (Figure 22 ). The Concept Grounded Report Generator generates a fluent, unstructured narrative from the discrete clinical findings and the image. The generation process is designed as a "concept-driven" synthesis, utilizing a finetuned multimodal model. The prompt used to generate this report is depicted in Figure 23 . Furthermore, the same concept grounded report generator is also used self refinement loop to generate the report of missing findings, as indicated by the prompt in Fig 24 .
blocks.zh: MeDPAO-VL遵循PAO环形逻辑,并在计划期间和观察剂运行周期状态期间战略性地使用LLM引擎. 在"计划状态"中,MCP客户端通过提供包括现有工具和任何先前执行的步骤在内的背景信息来查询LLM,提示引擎(图18)与其具体参数一起确定下一个合适的工具. 在央视状态期间,系统以工具生成的输出和原始用户查询两种方式呈现LLM(图19),要求评价回复是否充分满足了初始请求. 基于这一评估,LLM决定是继续穿越周期还是终止过程,并将当前产出作为最终结果返回. 该系统的所有单个工具调用都使用不同的速率来完成各项任务:概念提取(图20)、概念分类(图21)和结构化报告生成(图22)。 概念定位报告生成器从离散的临床发现和图像中产生流畅无序的叙述. 生成过程被设计为"概念驱动"的合成,采用微调的多式联运模式. 图23说明了编制本报告所用的提示。 此外,同一概念的基于报告生成器也用于自我完善循环,生成缺失结果报告,如图24的提示所示。
